tuleti.p: [Tula+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) It concentrates and contemplates (by wisdom). (B) Considers. (B) It investigates. (C) It contemplates and makes a decision. (D) It makes to be equal. (2) It weighs the pros and cons (by weight scale, etc.,).
